entities.name: Extended protocol configuration options
entities.description: This IE is included in messages when the UE needs to transmit protocol data such as configuration parameters, error codes, or messages/events to the network.

entities.name: User Equipment
entities.description: The UE includes the Extended protocol configuration options IE to transmit protocol data to the network.

entities.name: PDU session authentication and authorization procedure
entities.description: A procedure during which the Extended protocol configuration options IE may be used by the UE and network, though its usage is not specified in this release.

relations.description: The UE includes the Extended protocol configuration options IE when it needs to transmit protocol data to the network.
The IE may be used during the PDU session authentication and authorization procedure, though its usage is not specified in this release.
